name: Radimus Erkle's four Legends' Quest experience choices
observed_restrictions: Radimus offers four immediate 30,000 XP selections from twelve specified skills during the final Legends' Guild dialogue; the same skill may be selected four times. Previously completed accounts instead see the updated entitlement at Radimus.

evidence.note: One package, one producer; it reconciles both the choice review and Radimus retroactive review without duplicating 120,000 XP.
